description: factory-plugin-advisor: records a cli-failure occurrence when a Bash command running a software-factory marketplace plugin CLI exits non-zero (a factory exit 2, an escalation to a human, is not recorded). Claude Code reports a non-zero Bash exit as PostToolUseFailure (PostToolUse fires only for successful calls), so this runs only after failed Bash calls, in the background. It prints nothing and never blocks.
